contract.input_distribution: CPU fp32 normal(0,1)*0.125 before CPU dtype cast, for all precisions
contract.accumulation: fp16 promoted to fp32; fp32 unchanged
contract.shape_restriction: power-of-two scan widths 32..16384; original FP8 helper does not define masked partial-sum padding, so no partial padding is used
contract.tolerance_reason: FP32 atol2e-5 for prefix cancellation versus CPU fp64
contract.input_generation: CPU torch.randn fp32 with one CPU generator, then actual input dtype cast on CPU; integer indices use same generator
contract.baseline: official generic Triton; no B200-specific optimization claimed
contract.reference: independent CPU fp64 formula on actual rounded inputs
contract.reference_output_cast: FP8: quantize final mathematical result directly to actual output FP8 dtype then convert to fp64. FP16/FP32: unrounded CPU fp64 result.
contract.math_refs: Unquantized CPU fp64 mathematical results on actual rounded input values; log separately from storage-quantized refs
contract.fp8_tolerance: E4M3FN rtol=1/8 atol=2^-9; E5M2 rtol=1/4 atol=2^-16, one-output-ULP envelope against quantized reference; exact for gather/ReLU/max selection
contract.fp8_qualification: candidate only; serial runner must compile and pass two-shape gate before support is claimed
contract.timed_scope: preallocated outputs; only original Triton kernel launches; no native Torch compute, copies, allocation, or backward inside fn
contract.mutation: read-only inputs; output overwritten each call

sources.classification: official generic Triton; B200-specific tuning not established
